# Vendored Three.js (r160)

These files are copied verbatim from the npm package `three@0.160.0` so the
game runs with **zero external/CDN dependencies** (works fully offline).

- `three.module.js` — from `three/build/three.module.js`
- `addons/controls/OrbitControls.js` — from `three/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js`
